protocol.pre_read: For each selected prospective action, add a support field mapping its handle to a short exact quotation from the current event narrative that establishes its current trigger. If the narrative cannot support that handle, omit it from support. Do not quote from the menu or choice options.
protocol.preserve: Listed candidates were selected before the tool read and have exact quotations in the current event. Keep each candidate unless the actual tool reply explicitly invalidates its trigger, object or latest instruction. An unrelated new trigger is compatible with retaining an independently supported action. In the native choose JSON, include an optional invalidate object from candidate handle to a short exact quotation in the latest tool reply that invalidates it. Do not use hidden information or infer revocation from missing data. Continue to act on independently supported new triggers. This is the last model call.
